notes: H5A-D1-IR is the indoor surface-mount dome, IR-illuminator variant of Avigilon's H5A camera line (Motorola Solutions). It ships in multiple resolution SKUs — 2.0C-H5A-D1-IR, 4.0C-H5A-D1-IR, 6.0C-H5A-D1-IR, 8.0C-H5A-D1-IR — all sharing the same physical I/O per the official datasheet's line-wide "AUXILIARY I/O", "NETWORK", "PERIPHERALS", and "ELECTRICAL" tables. Not rack-mountable (dome form factor), so rackUnits omitted. A microSD/microSDHC/microSDXC onboard-storage slot exists but was omitted from ports since card slots aren't in the connector taxonomy. RS-485 terminal exists only on the Box variant (H5A-B), not this Dome model, so it was excluded. Audio and alarm I/O, and the local (non-PoE) power input, are delivered on the camera's own pigtail as flying/screw-terminal leads rather than as molded jacks — connector ids (trs-3.5, euroblock, euroblock-dc) are the closest catalog matches, which is why confidence is medium despite the core network/power specs coming directly from Avigilon's own PDF datasheet (avigilon-h5a-line-camera-datasheet-en.pdf, Rev 17, Oct 2023).

ports.name: Network (PoE)
ports.note: 100BASE-TX, RJ45, CAT5e cabling. Also delivers power to the camera via IEEE 802.3af Class 3 compliant PoE.

ports.name: DC/AC Power In
ports.note: Alternate to PoE: accepts 12 VDC ±10% (12 W min) or 24 VAC ±10% (13 VA min). Terminates as flying leads on the camera pigtail rather than a fixed connector body; closest catalog match is a DC terminal block.

ports.name: Alarm In
ports.note: External I/O terminal on the camera pigtail leads.

ports.name: Alarm Out
ports.note: External I/O terminal on the camera pigtail leads.

ports.name: Audio Line In
ports.note: Line-level audio input (G.711 PCM 8kHz, Opus). Native pigtail is flying leads; optional CM-AC-AVIO1 accessory (3.5 mm jack with 1.8 m fly wire) provides a standard 3.5 mm jack.

ports.name: Audio Line Out
ports.note: Line-level audio output. Same fly-wire/adapter caveat as Audio Line In.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB 2.0 host port, used e.g. for the optional USB-AC56 Wi-Fi adapter accessory.
